## File: facebookresearch_partnr-planner/third_party/habitat-lab/habitat-lab/habitat/articulated_agents/humanoids/kinematic_humanoid.py

Prompts

```
['create a KinematicHumanoid agent with agent_cfg and sim to instantiate a humanoid in the scene', 'set the humanoid joint positions, offset transform, and base transform using set_joint_transform', 'get the current joint positions and base transformation of the humanoid via get_joint_transform', 'set the humanoid base ground position to a desired Vector3 coordinate using the base_pos setter', 'reset the humanoid agent to its resting position by calling set_rest_position']
```

Usage

```
{'create_kinematic_humanoid': 'create a KinematicHumanoid agent with agent_cfg and sim to instantiate a humanoid in the scene', 'set_joint_transform': 'set the humanoid joint positions, offset transform, and base transform using set_joint_transform', 'get_joint_transform': 'get the current joint positions and base transformation of the humanoid via get_joint_transform', 'set_base_pos': 'set the humanoid base ground position to a desired Vector3 coordinate using the base_pos setter', 'set_rest_position': 'reset the humanoid agent to its resting position by calling set_rest_position'}
```
